notes: Connected OSM course candidate. The selected loop is the longest simple source-node cycle after explicit exclusions; its association with a named circuit configuration requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.

Draft association of the supplied venue-level entry to the existing independently mapped full course at Sokol International Racetrack. This venue has one supplied entry and one retained independent course, with a timing point on that course. Source trace distance 4464.2 m; supplied distance 4447 m. The association preserves the independent source geometry and remains provisional where corner configurations or historical distances differ.

attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 80 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
